title: The training principles series: natty lifting
summary: He defines 'natty' as someone who has never taken performance-enhancing drugs: one use and you can never be called natural again. He criticizes YouTube lifters who lie about PEDs and sell fake dreams, and says natural bodybuilding is a different thing from bodybuilding.

claims.claim: Natty means someone who has never taken performance-enhancing drugs (steroids); take them once and you can never be considered natural again.
It has become common for YouTube lifters to lie about PED use and sell fake dreams by claiming they got big just by working out.
In most cases there are visible signs that can pinpoint muscle-building drug use.
Natural bodybuilding is completely different from (enhanced) bodybuilding: the question is how big and strong you can get naturally and how.
